**Other information:**

**Problem.** `form/Container.scss` gives every direct child `margin-bottom: 10px` through
`.neo-form-container > *`. Two field roots set their own, different bottom margin at the *same*
specificity: `.neo-textfield` (5px, inherited by Number/Date/Time/etc.) and `.neo-file-upload-field`
(2.5rem, reserved for its error message). Since both rules tie on specificity, whichever stylesheet
the browser inserted **last** won. Neo inserts a class's stylesheet the first time an instance of that
class is created (`insertThemeFiles()` in `src/worker/App.mjs`), so the same form rendered with 5px or
10px of spacing depending on which component the app happened to create first — not on anything the
form's own markup controls.

**Fix.** Wrap the container's base rule in `:where()`, which contributes zero specificity, so a field's
own margin always wins:

```diff
 .neo-form-container {
     padding: 20px;
-
-    > * {
-       margin-bottom: 10px;
-
-        &:last-child {
-            margin-bottom: 0;
-        }
-    }
 }
+
+// A field's own margin wins; the container spaces only the children that set none.
+:where(.neo-form-container) > * {
+    margin-bottom: 10px;
+}
+
+.neo-form-container > *:last-child {
+    margin-bottom: 0;
+}
```

The last-child rule is untouched and keeps its `(0,2,0)` specificity, as called out in the issue.

**Test.** `test/playwright/component/form/Container.spec.mjs` builds the same three-child form (TextField,
FileUpload field, TextField) twice:
- once after the form is the first thing created,
- once after a standalone TextField and FileUpload field were created elsewhere first (so their
  stylesheets insert before the form's does).

Both assert the same `getComputedStyle(...).marginBottom`: `5px` for the first TextField, the upload
field's own `2.5rem` (computed in px) for the upload field, and `0px` for the last child.

Before this fix, the second test fails on `dev` (first TextField reads `10px`, reproducing the issue);
the first test happens to pass by accident of creation order. I verified this by temporarily reverting
the SCSS change and rebuilding the dev theme:

```
✓ a field keeps its own margin-bottom when its stylesheet loads after the container
✘ a field keeps its own margin-bottom when its stylesheet loaded before the container
  Expected: "5px"
  Received: "10px"
```

With the fix restored, both pass, and so does the rest of the `form` suite (37/37):

```
npm run test-components -- form
...
37 passed (29.2s)
```

**Scope note on the "Done when" list's screenshot item.** 11 files under `examples/` and `apps/` import
`form/Container.mjs`: `examples/layout/form/MainContainer.mjs`, `examples/component/toast/MainContainer.mjs`,
`examples/component/process/realWorldExample/MainContainer.mjs`, `examples/container/fragment/MainContainer.mjs`,
`apps/form/view/FormPageContainer.mjs`, `apps/form/view/FormContainer.mjs`, `apps/legit/view/AddFileDialog.mjs`,
`apps/realworld2/view/user/LoginFormContainer.mjs`, `apps/realworld2/view/user/SettingsFormContainer.mjs`,
`apps/realworld2/view/article/DetailsContainer.mjs`, `apps/realworld2/view/article/FormContainer.mjs`. I did not
launch each app to compare before/after screenshots — only a form whose app creates some other TextField-family
field *before* that form (so it was accidentally getting 10px today) would render differently, and the change
makes it 5px either way. I could not determine from a static read which (if any) of these apps hit that order,
so I'm flagging it rather than asserting none of them change.

# PR Micro-Review

**Opening**: Thank you, @Saadanjum0. Two things stand out: you proved the bug red-first on `dev` by reverting the SCSS and rebuilding the theme, and you flagged the screenshot item honestly instead of guessing. If you'd like to see more of the engine, [set up the Engine from a clone](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md#set-up-the-engine-from-a-clone) (three commands), then open `apps/workstation` and drag a tab out of the browser window ([why that works](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/learn/benefits/Introduction.md)). Your agent needs neither our Knowledge Base nor our Memory Core: `neo-agent-skills` is on npm.

**Class:** contained. One selector change that #19230 prescribed, plus its component spec. The PR introduces no concept beyond what the ticket already decided.

**Verdict:** Request Changes

**Glance:** At head `2793c1dd`, the SCSS is the ticket's decided fix:
- `:where(.neo-form-container) > *` contributes (0,0,0), so `.neo-textfield` and `.neo-file-upload-field` at (0,1,0) win in any load order.
- The untouched last-child rule keeps (0,2,0), and the one-line why is there.
- CI is green (32/32), and no file outside the two the ticket names changed.
- Your note on the 11 forms is enough for the screenshot item: a static read can't tell creation order, and the maintainers' post-merge check covers it.

I found one problem, in the spec. It reads `getComputedStyle` as soon as an element exists, but Neo doesn't wait for a class's stylesheet before it renders. `insertThemeFiles` asks the main thread to add the `<link>` and only counts the pending loads (`countLoadingThemeFiles` in `src/worker/App.mjs`). So a read can land before a stylesheet has loaded. In the second test that cuts the wrong way: on `dev`, the form's fields can read `5px` from the already-loaded `Text.css` before `Container.css` arrives and turns them into `10px`. The test that should catch the bug could then pass on the bug.

**Findings:**
- [ ] Wait for the stylesheets before reading any margin. Add a helper and call it after each `createNeoInstance(...)` and its `waitForSelector(...)`, before the first `marginBottomOf(...)`:
  ```js
  async function stylesheetsLoaded(page, names) {
      await page.waitForFunction(names => {
          const links = [...document.querySelectorAll('link[rel="stylesheet"]')];

          return names.every(name => links.some(link => link.href.includes(name))) && links.every(link => link.sheet)
      }, names)
  }

  // e.g. in both tests, once the form exists:
  await stylesheetsLoaded(page, ['/form/Container.css', '/form/field/Text.css', '/form/field/FileUpload.css']);
  ```
  A `<link>` has its `sheet` only once it has loaded, and theme files arrive as `css/<folder>/<class path>.css` (`Stylesheet.addThemeFiles` in `src/main/addon/Stylesheet.mjs`). A file that never loads makes the wait fail loudly instead of reading defaults. Then rerun your red check: on `dev`, the second test should still read `10px`.
